channel.title: The Pagic blog
channel.description: Guides to customizing websites in Chrome, from the maker of Pagic.

item.title: Does Dia Have Boosts? What Arc Users Should Know
item.description: Dia doesn't have Arc's Boosts and can't import them. Here's what moves from Arc to Dia, what doesn't, and how to get Boosts back in Dia with an extension.

item.title: How to Hide YouTube Shorts on Desktop (For Good)
item.description: YouTube has no off switch for Shorts on desktop. Here's how to hide the Shorts shelf, tab and search results in Chrome, and keep them hidden every visit.

item.title: How to Customize Any Website in Chrome (No Code)
item.description: Hide clutter, change colors and fonts, add dark mode, move things around and leave notes on any website in Chrome, without code. A complete guide.

item.title: How to Get Dark Mode on Any Website in Chrome
item.description: Three ways to force dark mode on every website in Chrome: the hidden flag, Dark Reader, and Pagic. Which keeps photos right, and how to set it per site.

item.title: 8 Best Chrome Extensions to Customize Websites (2026)
item.description: The best Chrome extensions to change how websites look: hide elements, dark mode, custom CSS, feed blockers and highlights. Compared by the maker of one.

item.title: Arc Boosts Alternative: Keep Your Boosts After Arc Shuts Down
item.description: Arc stops working on December 22, 2026, and Dia can't import Boosts. Here's how to keep your colors, fonts, zaps and custom CSS in Chrome.
